settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Language, AI models and spending limits.
settings.languageDescription: Language of the app. The AI replies in the language you write to it.
settings.modelsDescription: Pick the default Claude model and, if you like, a different model or effort level for individual tasks. Higher effort means more careful answers, more time and higher cost.
settings.accessUnavailable: Not available for this API key
settings.accessDemo: Demo mode: all models appear available.
settings.accessError: Could not reach the Anthropic API: {message}
settings.budgetDescription: Background work (bulk analysis, searches, research) pauses when a cap is reached. Chats keep working but show a warning.
settings.monthlyCapHint: Leave empty for no monthly cap.
settings.keysDescription: Keys are read from .env.local in the project folder and never stored in the database. Restart the app after changing them.
settings.searchDescription: How much AI work each search run may do. Higher numbers find more but cost more.
settings.screenTopNHint: The most relevant new jobs get a quick Interview Chance check (about $0.02–0.05 each with Opus).
settings.deepTopN: Best matches to read in full
settings.deepTopNHint: The top results are re-read from the full posting and analysed in depth (about $0.15–0.30 each).

sources.title: Job sources
sources.description: Where searches look for jobs. SEEK and LinkedIn have no job-search API, so Huntloop reads them in its own visible browser window on this computer — only if you turn them on.
sources.riskPacing: Huntloop only reads the site when you start a search or add a link, slowly (a few seconds between pages, at most the number of job pages you set).
sources.riskVisible: Everything happens in a visible browser window you can watch. If the site asks for a check or a sign-in, Huntloop stops and waits for you.
sources.riskNoEvasion: Huntloop never hides that it's automated, solves CAPTCHAs, or uses tricks to avoid detection.
sources.maxPagesHint: The most job pages Huntloop opens on this site in one search.
sources.browserFailed: Huntloop couldn't open a browser. Install Google Chrome, or set HUNTLOOP_BROWSER_PATH in .env.local to a Chrome or Chromium executable.

seek.name: SEEK (Australia and New Zealand)
seek.description: Searches seek.com.au and seek.co.nz and reads each job in full.
seek.risk: SEEK's terms of use don't allow automated access. Using it this way is for your personal job search only, at your own risk.

linkedin.name: LinkedIn Jobs
linkedin.description: Searches LinkedIn's public job listings (guest mode, no account needed) and reads each job in full.
linkedin.risk: LinkedIn's terms of use don't allow automated access, and LinkedIn may restrict accounts it believes are automated. Guest mode keeps your account out of it. Use at your own risk, for your personal job search only.
linkedin.useLoginHint: You sign in yourself in Huntloop's browser window; Huntloop never sees your password. This puts your account at risk if LinkedIn flags the activity — guest mode is safer.

agent.name: AI browsing agent
agent.description: Claude browses sites in Huntloop's browser window (through Chrome DevTools): job sites you list below, SEEK or LinkedIn if their pages change, and "find this job on the employer's site".
agent.noticeCost: Each run costs more than other searches — roughly $0.50–2 with Opus — and counts towards your spending cap.
agent.noticeGuard: It can only search and read: Huntloop refuses any apply, sign-in, message, connect, save or upload action, keeps it on the allowed sites, and pauses for you on any check or sign-in.
agent.noticeTerms: Only list sites whose terms allow you to browse them this way.
agent.fallback: Let it take over when SEEK or LinkedIn return no jobs
agent.fallbackHint: Useful if one of those sites changes its pages. Only when that site is turned on above.
agent.sitesHint: Job boards without an API or adapter, e.g. a government jobs site. Give its search page; searches will include them.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.subtitle: Huntloop compares every job against this profile. Only facts here count as evidence.

upload.title: Start with your CV
upload.description: Huntloop reads your CV once and turns it into a structured profile you can edit. Your confirmed work rights and facts are kept when you replace it.
upload.fileHint: PDF, Word (.docx) or plain text, up to 10 MB.
upload.pastePlaceholder: Paste the full text of your CV here
upload.privacy: Your CV is stored on this computer and sent only to the Claude API to be read.
upload.stageAnalyzing: Claude is reading your CV. This usually takes under a minute.
upload.done: Done — your profile is ready below.

profile.name: Name
profile.headline: Headline
profile.workRightsDescription: Whether you can work in a country without sponsorship decides many applications before anyone reads your CV. Huntloop uses this to flag jobs you can't be hired for.
profile.experienceYears: {years} years in total (overlapping roles counted once)
profile.highlightsHint: One per line, as on your CV.
profile.dateError: Check the start and end dates of your roles (YYYY-MM or YYYY).
profile.skillsDescription: Everything you can be assessed on. Add skills you have even if your CV doesn't mention them yet.
profile.clearancesDescription: Some government and defence roles require one.
profile.factsDescription: True things that aren't on your CV (e.g. "Used Kafka in production at Acme"). Huntloop can use them as evidence and will suggest adding them to your CV.
profile.newFactPlaceholder: e.g. Led a team of 4 engineers for 1 year
profile.cvTextDescription: The exact text Huntloop quotes as evidence. Fix anything that was read incorrectly.

preferences.rolesDescription: Used to search and to focus the AI on what matters to you.

preferences.citiesHint: Leave empty for anywhere in the country.
preferences.salaryFloorHint: Optional. Used to filter, not to judge your chances.
preferences.excludedCompaniesHint: Jobs from these companies are hidden.
preferences.maxPostingAgeHint: Older postings are less likely to lead to an interview.
preferences.notesHint: Deal-breakers, wishes, context — the AI reads this.
